o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,include_depth=True)
count=0

def save(res):
 global o,count
 o=res; count+=1
 res.save('/app/output/step%02d'%count)
 p=res.meta['proprio']['now']
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k not in ['proprio','cameras']}),flush=True)
 print('EE',p[14:28],'TCP',p[56:70],'opening',p[36],p[43],flush=True)

def move(left=None,right=None,lg=None,rg=None,note=''):
 p=o.meta['proprio']['now']
 a=list(p[14:21])+[p[28]]+list(p[21:28])+[p[29]]
 if left is not None:a[:7]=left
 if right is not None:a[8:15]=right
 if lg is not None:a[7]=lg
 if rg is not None:a[15]=rg
 save(r.submit('ee_pose',[a],cameras=cameras,include_depth=True,note=note))

def grip(l=None,rr=None):
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:14]);end=p.copy()
 if l is not None:end[6]=l
 if rr is not None:end[13]=rr
 save(r.submit('joint_position',np.linspace(p,end,21),dt=.05,cameras=cameras,include_depth=True,note='gripper closure'))

print('READY',flush=True)
while True:
 line=sys.stdin.readline()
 if not line:break
 with open('/app/output/commands.log','a') as f:f.write(line)
 try:exec(line)
 except Exception as e:print(type(e).__name__,str(e),flush=True)
